intended_object: The forward Shapiro map on continuous 2-cocycles, Z²_cts(G, Coind_U^G A) → Z²_cts(U, A), f ↦ ((u,v) ↦ f(u,v)(1)). It is restriction to U followed by the counit (evaluation at 1) and induces Shapiro's isomorphism H²(G, Coind_U^G A) ≅ H²(U, A). Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The body is the library's generic pullback of continuous 2-cocycles (cocyclesMap2) along the compatible pair (inclusion U ↪ G, evaluation at 1 on DiscreteCoind). It is supplied with the continuity of evaluation and the compatibility eval(u•f) = u•eval f. DiscreteCoind is the discrete coinduced module: locally constant functions f : G → A with f(ug) = u•f(g), with the discrete topology. Evaluation at 1 is its counit. The lemma shapiroCocycles2_apply confirms that the image at (u,v) is f(u,v)(1), which is the textbook Shapiro map on cocycles. The hypotheses (topological group G, subgroup U, discrete U-module A) are the natural setting for continuous cohomology with discrete coefficients; profiniteness and closedness of U are only used later, to prove bijectivity. Mathlib has Shapiro's lemma only for abstract groups, as an isomorphism on cohomology rather than a map on continuous cocycles, so it has no counterpart for this map.
